title: Write the sum
text: Each week has $$7$$ days, so the total is $$7$$ times the sum of $$1+\frac{i-1}{10}$$ for i from $$1$$ to $$25$$.

title: Evaluate
text: The sum of $$1$$ is $$25$$, and the sum of $$(i-1)$$ is $$0+1+...+24=300$$. So the total is $$7\left(25+\frac{300}{10}\right)=7\times55=385$$ miles.
